strings.name: Azim Premji
strings.summary: Premji took over his family business after his father’s death and led Wipro from cooking oil into electronics, software and technology services. After retiring as executive chairman in 2019, he remained a non-executive director and founder chairman. He committed substantial wealth to a foundation supporting Indian public education, teacher development and wider social development. These outcomes reflect collective corporate, educational and philanthropic work.
